msg: No Contact field. RFC 9116 makes Contact mandatory, and the CRA single reporting contact point has nowhere to land.
Contact must be a URI (mailto:, tel: or https://), not a bare address.
No Expires field. Expires is mandatory and a file without it is not a valid security.txt.
Expires must be a full RFC 3339 timestamp, e.g. 2027-03-01T00:00:00Z.
Expires is in the past, so RFC 9116 says the file MUST be ignored: the reporter has no contact point.
Expires is more than 365 days out; RFC 9116 says the value should be less than a year.
This field may appear only once in the file.
Web URIs in security.txt must use https://, never http://.
Canonical should point at https://<domain>/.well-known/security.txt, the only location scanners read.
No Policy field. The CRA expects a published coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy for the reporter to follow.
CSAF must point at a provider-metadata.json URI, not at an index or a single advisory.
Field name is not in the RFC 9116 registry, so parsers drop the line.
Line is not in "Field: value" form, so it is not parsed at all.
